in_marathi.name: Devkaran
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God's labor, God's work
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devkaran हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Devi (Goddess) + Kara (work) + An (male) = God's labor, God's work. This name is derived from the Sanskrit language and holds significant meaning in Hindu mythology.
